title: dactylorhiza incarnata var. drudei
intro: Dactylorhiza incarnata var. drudei, commonly known as the Drude's marsh orchid, is a type of orchid found in various parts of the world, particularly in wetland areas. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Dactylorhiza incarnata var. drudei include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce swelling and protect cells from damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
